meta.title: Wursha — Quran Mushaf apps with tafsir and recitation
meta.description: Five Mushaf editions (Madina, Tajweed, Warsh, Qalun, Shamarly) with 50+ tafsir and translation books and 200+ reciters. Free, with no ads, for iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows.

hero.title: The *Mushaf* you know, with everything around it
hero.subtitle: Original Mushaf pages, 50+ books of tafsir and translation, and 200+ reciters, in one app. Free, with no ads.
hero.platforms: For iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac and Windows.
hero.imageAlt: Two facing pages of the Madina Mushaf in the app

editions.title: Choose your Mushaf
editions.subtitle: Every edition has the same tafsir library, recitations and tools. Choose the Mushaf and the riwaya you read from.

madina.name: Madina Mushaf
madina.line: The familiar Madina pages, with farsh marks where the qira'at differ

tajweed.name: Tajweed Mushaf
tajweed.line: Every tajweed rule marked in color, with a legend for each color

warsh.name: Warsh Mushaf
warsh.line: The places where Warsh differs from Hafs, marked in color

qalon.name: Qalun Mushaf
qalon.line: With reciters of the Qalun narration built in

shamarli.name: Shamarly Mushaf
shamarli.line: The 522-page Shamarly Mushaf, with qira'at notes in the margins

story.title: Inside every edition
story.subtitle: The same tools come with all five Mushafs.

scenes.title: The *meaning* of every verse
scenes.subtitle: Tafsir, translation and word meanings
items: Tap a verse for its tafsir, or a word for its meaning and grammar
Al-Mukhtasar, Al-Muyassar, Ibn Kathir, As-Sa'di, Al-Qurtubi and more
Translations in English, French, German, Turkish, Indonesian, Malay, Urdu and more

scenes.title: Listen to *200+ reciters*
scenes.subtitle: Full surahs and playlists
items: Full-surah recitations in Tartil, the recitation library
A mini player that stays with you while you read

scenes.title: Repeat to *memorize*
scenes.subtitle: Set repeats, pauses and speed
items: Verse-by-verse recitation that highlights the verse being read
Repeat a verse or a passage as many times as you like
A pause between repeats, and speed control
scenes.note: The audio menu is in Arabic in every interface language.

scenes.title: Easy on your eyes *at night*
scenes.subtitle: Night mode and page colors
items: Night mode and several page colors
Auto-scroll at the speed you choose
Two pages side by side when you turn your device

scenes.title: Several *khatmas* at once
scenes.subtitle: Each keeps its place and reciter
items: Each khatma has its own page, bookmarks, notes and reciter
Search with or without diacritics, or by root

scenes.title: Your daily *adhkar*
scenes.subtitle: Counter, beads and your own list
items: A counter, tasbih beads and audio
Duas from the Quran and Sunnah

scenes.title: Share a verse *as an image*
scenes.subtitle: Beautiful and ready to post
items: Share as an image, or as text with its tafsir
Saved to Photos only when you choose to

library.title: The library
library.subtitle: 50+ books of tafsir, Quran sciences, qira'at and translation. Some download once, then stay on your device.

languages.title: In your language
languages.subtitle: The app interface comes in 14 languages.
languages.note: Surah names, tafsir book titles and adhkar texts stay in Arabic in every language.

downloads.title: Download
downloads.subtitle: Free on every platform, with no ads.
